privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.nothingMeasured: This service does not measure its traffic and sends its errors to no external tool.

audience.title: Audience measurement
audience.purpose: We measure the traffic of the service and the use of its features with Umami, an open source tool hosted by the operator of the service, in order to improve it. No data is shared with a third party.
audience.collected: Umami records the pages you visit and some actions, such as creating, publishing or exporting a presentation. It also records the site you come from, your browser, your system, your language, your country and the size of your screen.
audience.anonymous: These statistics are anonymous: they contain neither your account nor the name or the content of your presentations. For a public presentation, Umami also records its address and its title.
audience.limits: Umami sets no cookie and does not follow you from one site to another.
audience.retention: This data is kept for {n} month. | This data is kept for {n} months.

errors.title: Error tracking
errors.collected: When an error occurs, a technical report is sent to GlitchTip, an open source tool hosted by the operator of the service, so that we can fix it. The report contains the error message, the address of the page, your truncated IP address, your browser and your system. It contains neither your account nor your cookies, but an error message may quote an excerpt of a presentation.
errors.retention: These reports are kept for {n} day. | These reports are kept for {n} days.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.list: This service sets only the cookies it needs to work: your sign-in session, the language of the interface, your display preferences, the page to reopen after signing in and the access to presentations protected by a password.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.contact: For any question about your data or to exercise your rights, write to {contact}.
